visual.result: Partial visual pass: selected Linux and WASM captures inspected. Prey walker and Small Leech worm silhouettes, dry visual hop, river-side body, thrown elevated offspring and ground shadows are visible. Source sprite parity and all-angle/crowd readability remain open.
observations: Native live Prey stands near the north canyon wall; its live Small Leech pursues the player.
Native death/landed captures show three independent death children in addition to the already existing live child. During launch the children can visually overlap; after landing they separate.
WASM death capture shows the three airborne bodies near the top of the view and their separated ground shadows; the airborne height is visible without a new render style.

River captures show a Small Leech at the player bank after crossing. The screenshot alone does not prove traversed distance; native swept-water tests and browser telemetry provide the movement evidence.
Natural Prey capture includes the production room residents and scenery. Ordinary crowd overlap and distant silhouettes still need broader readability review.
limits: Only selected camera positions and frames were inspected; no animation/artwork or full visual-equivalence acceptance.
FPS counters captured during builds/tests are not controlled performance measurements.
Current worm/walker bodies are existing Original-style generic visuals, not newly authored source sprites.

adaptations: Source HP x3.2 and distances x.1. Half-heart contact maps to10 before existing1.25 multiplier. Original visuals and player defaults unchanged.
Source30Hz wet/dry control runs within60Hz simulation. Physical room bounds constrain source margins to local body radius; ground navigation/body avoidance remain DeathWard adaptations.
Flooded rooms and rooms intersected by interior rivers use room-wide wet behavior. Swimming crosses water while preserving rocks, gates, raised terrain and room boundaries.

Death launch uses source height-10, velocity-8, gravity+.7 and planar.04 times target delta. Height scale.1 yields23sourceupdate flight. Actual3D elevation drives rendering; airborne state excludes projectile/body contact but not area damage.

Nearby launch destination uses bounded local free-point search with radius8 and scatter1. Full3D arc and actual endpoint are validated before admission; vertical fallback or retained birth replaces invalid source-grid destinations. This can reject arcs Isaac sprite collision permits.
Dry Hop10/Land6 remains a grounded collider with small local visual lift. Live children are grounded and persistent.
Population death count applies native817adjustment/minimum with zero NPC+bc6 counter. Reserved births count toward capacity/room completion; dead carrier removal never discards admitted requests.
Local wet band1 pursuit weights/costs/caps adapt Downpour/Dross and FloodedCaves habitats, not source room-template probabilities.
